nodes.title: SG-6.2 Second NPC scene unit tests with mocked dependencies
nodes.body:
Context: characterSchema, validateWorld scene character checks, resolveCharacterAnimation and BootScene.createCharacter already exist, but the only tested character is the boy. Desired behavior: unit tests with every dependency mocked load a scene containing a second NPC from data. Expected result: tests prove it validates, is spawned, resolves its idle animation from the manifest, and that an unknown NPC reference is rejected. Why: guards data-driven NPC support.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene with a second NPC whose id is in the world list, when sceneSchema and validateWorld run, then both accept it with no errors
- Given a loaded scene with boy and a second NPC, when BootScene.create runs, then two character sprites are created and each plays its own idle animation key
- Given the NPC idle ref points to a manifest asset, when resolveCharacterAnimation runs, then it returns that asset and animation
- Given a scene NPC id absent from world.characters, when validateWorld runs, then it returns a path-tagged unknown character error


## Scope
- In scope: New unit tests for the second NPC
- In scope: Minimal product exports the tests need
- Out of scope: New artwork or manifest assets
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Browser or e2e checks
- Preserve: Existing character tests
- Preserve: Existing the-boys-room content


## Technical constraints
- Vitest only
- Phaser, fs and content mocked or in-memory


## Definition of done
- All requirement tickets have passing Verify units


## Non-functional requirements
- Each test file runs in seconds


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · A second NPC is spawned and resolves its idle animation from the manifest
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.createCharacter uses resolveCharacterAnimation and ensureAnim. Desired behavior: with a mocked Phaser and a content mock holding boy and npc, create() adds two sprites and plays character:npc:idle. Expected result: a pure key helper and BootScene agree. Why: proves manifest-driven animation for NPCs.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a manifest with asset character:npc defining idle, when resolveCharacterAnimation runs for the NPC idle, then it returns character:npc and idle
- Given a mocked scene with boy and npc, when BootScene.create runs, then add.sprite is called twice and the NPC sprite plays character:npc:idle


## Scope
- In scope: characterAnimationKey helper
- In scope: BootScene spawn test
- Out of scope: Real SVG assets
- Preserve: resolveCharacterAnimation fallback behavior


## Technical constraints
- Phaser mocked with vi.mock as in bootSceneCharacters.test.ts


## Definition of done
- Act and Verify units complete


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · An invalid NPC reference is rejected
nodes.body:
Context: validateWorld pushes scenes[id].characters[i].id errors. Desired behavior: a scene with an NPC id not in world.characters yields a path-tagged error. Expected result: exact error string for the bad index only. Why: stops dangling NPC references.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given scene characters boy and ghost and world list boy, when validateWorld runs, then errors equal the single ghost message at index 1
- Given an NPC id missing from the world, when validateWorld runs, then the result is non-empty so loading is rejected


## Scope
- In scope: validateWorld NPC rejection
- Out of scope: Changing error wording
- Preserve: Existing validator tests


## Technical constraints
- In-memory data only


## Definition of done
- Act and Verify units complete


## Clarifying questions
- None
